verbetes.glosa_atual: (= גלגליתא, v. גַּלְגְּלָא, cmp. גַּרְגַּר) trabalho com rodas, poço para irrigação de campos.
definicoes_originais: (= גלגליתא, v. גַּלְגְּלָא, cmp. גַּרְגַּר) wheel-work, well for irrigating fields.
notas_originais: Ber. 58 a; B. Bath. 91 b (prov.) אפי' ריש ג' וכ' (Ber. ed. גרגי', Ms. M. גדגיד', corr. acc., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) even a superintendent of the well (cmp. בַּיָּיר) is appointed in heaven. B. Kam. 27 b. B. Mets. 103 a if one says, ‘Lend me ההיא ג' the use of this well’, he may restore &c.; בי ג' ‘a place (in the field) for a well’,—he may go on digging wells until he strikes one that suits him. B. Bath. 56 a.— Pl. גַּרְגּוּתֵי. B. Mets. l. c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גַּרְגַּתְנִי Ar.) f. (v.גּוּרְגָּא); um vime ou rede no lagar de vinho ou azeite.; (de sua superfície enrugada) a superfície cicatrizada e sem vida de uma ferida curada, escara.
definicoes_originais: a wicker or net work in the wine or oil press.
(from its shrivelled surface) the scarry and lifeless surface of a healed up wound, eschar.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 56 b החזיר ג' לגת if he placed the net (once used) back into the vat. Ḥag. 22 b גורג' some ed.; Tosef. ib. III, 4. Lev. R. s. 22 he gathered the vessels of the Temple ונתנן לתוך ג' and placed them in a net; Gitt. 56 b he took the curtain ועשאו כמין ג' and shaped it like &c. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 5.
B. Kam. 85 a העלתה מכתו ג' if, through neglect of medical advice, the wound became scabby; Y. ib. 6 b bot. [read:] עלתה בו ג'.
, v. גַּרְגִּירָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido. art. a. גּוּרְגָּא) redes, filtros.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced. art. a. גּוּרְגָּא) nets, filters.
notas_originais: Tosef. Kil. V, 25 ed. Zuck., v. אכסלית.
Gen. R. s. 79; Yalk. ib. 133 שוקא דג' wicker market (differ. in Koh. R. to X, 8).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גרר); [a planta estimulante,] rúcula-de-jardim, Eruca (v. Sm. Ant. s. v.).; grão, baga, v. גַּרְגַּר.
definicoes_originais: [ the stimulating plant,] garden-rocket, Eruca (v. Sm. Ant. s. v.).
notas_originais: Yoma 18 b; Yalk. Kings 228. Tosef. Shebi. II, 9; Erub. 28 a sq. (Ar. ed. Koh. גרגל).—Shebi. IX, 1 גרגר של אפר (comment. גרגיר) field-rocket, Eruca agrestis.—[

Yoma 18 b ג' מצרנאה rocket growing on the balk (Ms. M. מצראה). Sabb. 109 a (Ar. ed. Koh. גַּרְגִּילָא; Yalk. Kings 228 גַּרְגְּרָא).—Gitt. 69 b גַּלְגִּילָא ed. (Ar. s. v. בזר: גַּרְגִּילָא). Ab. Zar. 10 b, v. גּוּר II.—[
, v. גַּרְגּוּתָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= גלגליד'; גלד) fatia; ג' דליפתא uma fatia de nabo, esp. a fatia superior.
definicoes_originais: (= גלגליד'; גלד) slice; ג' דליפתא a slice of turnip, esp. the upper slice.
notas_originais: Bekh. 43 b one whose head resembles לגרגלידה דל' Ar. (ed. לגדגלידא, corr. acc.) the upper portion &c. (expl. לפתם ib. VII, 1).— Pl. גַּרְגְּלִידֵי. Ber. 39 a (Ar. גורג'). Ib. 56 a (Var. in Ar. ראשי לפתות). Keth. 61 a
, v. גְּרַף

verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de (denominação de גָּרוֹן, גַּרְגֶּרֶת) para derramar na garganta, opp. שתה para colocar os lábios no recipiente.; denominação de גַּרְגַּר) para colher frutas individuais.; (denominação de גְּרוֹגֶרֶת) para deixar a azeitona murchar (na árvore ou ao sol no telhado), para marcar para murchar.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of (denom. of גָּרוֹן, גַּרְגֶּרֶת) to pour down the throat, opp. שתה to set the lips to the vessel.
denom. of גַּרְגַּר) to pick single berries.
(denom. of גְּרוֹגֶרֶת) to let the olive shrivel (on the tree or in the sun on the roof), to mark out for shrivelling.
notas_originais: Par. IX, 4; Tosef. ib. IX (VIII), 6.—*Gitt. 89 a גִּירְגְּרָה בשוק if she quaffs outdoors; [Rashi: walks with outstretched neck (גָּרוֹן)].
Maasr. II, 6 מְגַרְגֵּר ואוכל he may pick grapes (from the hanging cluster) and eat; ib. III, 9; Y. ib. II, 50 a top.

Ex. R. s. 36 that olive—while it is yet on its tree, מְגַרְגְּרִין אותו they mark it out for shrivelling (in order to use it for the press). Men. VIII, 4 מְגַרְגְּרוֹ בראש הזית he lets it shrivel on the top of the olive tree; מג' בראש הגג in the sun on the roof; [for oth. opin. v. Rashi a. l.].—Ib. 86 a מְגרְגְּרוֹ תנן או מְגַלְגְּלֹו תנן does it read m’garg’ro (he lets it shrivel) or m’galg’lo (he lets it hang until it is fully rounded)?

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido.) para crescer frutos, para amadurecer em frutos inteiros.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced.) to grow berries, to ripen into full berries.
notas_originais: —Part. pass. מְגַרְגַּר. Targ. Ps. I, 3 ed. Lag. (some ed. סגרגר).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.; גרר = גלל) baga, grão, pilha (de seixos).; (= גְּרֹוגֶרֶת) a azeitona murcha.; foguete, v.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.; גרר = גלל) berry, grain, heap ( of pebbles).
notas_originais: Peah VII, 4 ג' יחידי single berries (not growing in bunches). Shebi. III, 7 (Bart. גרגיר) a heap of pebbles.—Tosef. Sabb. II, 8 גרגיר של מלח a globule of salt. Sabb. VI, 5 בפלפל בגרגיר מלח (Y. ed. גרגר, Bab. ed. 64 b, 65 a גלגל, Ms. O. גרגר).— Pl. גַּרְגְּרִים, גַּרְגְּרִין. Peah VI, 5; a. e.
Pl. as above. Men. VIII, 3 (85 b), v. גִּרְגֵּר.—[
— Pl. גַּרְגְּרִין. Targ. Is. XVII, 6.—Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 14 גַּרְגִּירֵי חיטיהון their wheat grains.—[

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גרר, v. próximo w.) rodas de um poço.
definicoes_originais: (גרר, v. next w.) wheel-works of a well.
notas_originais: Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3) ג' דאע wooden wheel-works.
, v. גַּרְגּוּתָא

Y. Ber. VI, 10 c top, v. גַּרְגְּרָנוּת. Pes. 86 b; a. fr.—Nidd. X, 8 (of one unable to control his sexual appetite).— Pl. גַּרְגְּרָנִין. Yoma 39 a bot., opp. צנועין.—Fem. גַּרְגְּרָנִית. Pl. גַּרְגְּרָנִיֹּות (unable to resist tasting temptation). Gen. R. s. 45; Deut. R. s. 6 (ref. to Gen. III, 6).
Targ. Y. Deut. XXI, 20.— Pl. גַּרְגְּרָנֵי. Keth. 60 b Ar. Var. (ed. גירדני, v. גַּרְדָּנָא).—Fem. גַּרְגְּרָנִיתָא. Targ. Lam. I, 11 (h. text זוללה).
Y. Ber. VI, 10 c top לא לזה גורגרן … בגַרְגְּרָנוּתֹו וכ' not this greedy man must be laughed at, but thou, the sneerer; he acted hastily in his greed &c.
, v. גַּרְגְּרָן h. a. ch.

verbetes.glosa_atual: por favor. גַּרְגְּרֹות pescoço; גרגר; גָּרַר, a. גֵּרָה) garganta, esófago; (na lei ritual) traqueia, traqueia.
definicoes_originais: pl. גַּרְגְּרֹות neck; גרגר; v. גָּרַר, a. גֵּרָה) throat, gullet; (in ritual law) wind-pipe, trachea.
notas_originais: Koh. R. to XII, 6; Lev. R. s. 18, v. גָּלָה Hif.—Ex. R. s. 24 the Lord created for man מעין בתוך גַּרְגַּרְתֹּו a well (mucous membranes) in the trachea. Ḥull. II, 4 פסק את הג' he tore open (instead of cutting) the trachea. Ib. III, 3 פסוקת הג' an animal with a split between the rings of the wind-pipe.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (= גשגש'; גשש) = h. גּוּשׁ,; torrão, pedaço de terra.; uma certa argila avermelhada, usada também como remédio.
definicoes_originais: a certain reddish clay, used also as medicine.
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. XVIII, 43. Targ. Job VII, 5 (h. text גוש). Targ. Y. Gen. I, 24; a. fr.— Pl. גַּרְגְּשָׁתָא, גַּרְגִּישָׁ'. Targ. Job XXI, 33; XXXVIII, 38 (h. text רגבים).

B. Mets. 40 a משום ג' the difference of opinion as regards leakage (v. בֶּלַע) arises from the different qualities of the clay used for the vessels. Nidd. 20 a bot. broke apart קורטא דג' a piece of potter’s clay. Keth. 60 b דאכלה גרגוש' a woman who eats gargushta (as an astringent or in place of a cosmetic; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Creta). Ab. Zar. 38 b
, v. גַּרְגּוּתְנִי

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. coçar, raspar, pentear.; (denominação de גֶּרֶד 2) para cortar a teia com suas franjas do tear.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of גֶּרֶד 2) to cut the web with its fringes off the loom.
notas_originais: Sabb. VIII, 6 (81 a) לִגְרֹוד Ar. a. ed. Y.; a. fr. [Editions a. Mss. mostly גָּרַר q. v.]— Part. pass. גָּרוּד stripped, v. גַּרְדּוּם.

Yoma 72 b (expl. בגדי השרד Ex. XXXV, 19) בגדים שגֹּורְדִין אותן כברייתן מכליהן וכ' webs which they cut off the looms in their needed shape (so as to require no tailoring), leaving a small portion of the unwoven threads.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ;; raspar, pentear, despir; trnsf. castigar.; esfregar, criar fricção (de conexão sexual).; para estimular o apetite.
definicoes_originais: to scrape, comb, strip; trnsf. to chastise.
to rub, create friction (of sexual connection).
notas_originais: Targ. Jud. VIII, 16 וגרד Regia (ed. Lag. גרר, oth. ed. תבר; h. text וַיֹּדַע).—Naz. 4 b, v. גְּרִי.—Part. pass. גְּרִיד. Sabb. 109 b דגְרִידָא מעילאי וכ' which has been stripped of its rind from the top downward.
—Part. גָּרֵיד. Yeb. 75 b.—[
Ber. 35 b, a. fr. Ar. (ed. a. Ms. mostly גְּרַר).] [ Ithpa., v. גְּרַר.] V. גרע, גרר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גרד); apagamento.; aquilo que é penteado, franja.
notas_originais: Men. 30 b Ar. (ed. גֶּרֶר).
— Pl. גְּרָדִין. Ib. 42 b; Succ. 9 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; pentear; ג' דסרבלא a remoção da superfície lanosa de um pano grosso.; franja, linha.
definicoes_originais: combing; ג' דסרבלא the removal of the woolly surface of a thick cloth.
notas_originais: B. Kam. 99 a; B. Mets. 112 a.—M. Kat. 23 a went out בג' דס' (Ms. M. 2 בגררא) in a fresh scraped and smoothed cloak.

Sabb. 134 a דילמא מידביק ג' מיניה (Var. מדביקא גרדתא, v. Rashi a. l.) lest a thread of it stick to the membrum.— Pl. גַּרְדַּיָּא, גַּרְדֵּי, גַּרְדִּין. Targ. Y. Num. XV, 38 (ref. to Men. 42 b).—Bekh. 8 b כרוכו לי ג' מיניה וכ' twist for me threads pulled out of it, and I will sew it. Men. 31 b. [גַּרְדָּא or גְּרָדָא scraping, v. גִּירְדָּא.—גְּרָדָא cud, v. גְּרָרָא I.]
, v. גַּרְדַּי

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גרדם) um toco.; —um toco, ou seja, sem qualquer descrição do que levou consigo (opp. à descrição do retorno à Palestina, Esdras II, 66); [Sim. Esdras 1067 גָּדוּד, v. eu.
definicoes_originais: —a stump, i.e. without any description as to what he took with him (opp. to the description of the return to Palestine, Ezra II, 66); [Yalk. Ezra 1067 גָּדוּד, v. גָּדַד; ib.
notas_originais: Ruth R. s. 1 end וילך איש ג' ‘and a man went’ (Ruth I,

Ruth 598 גָּרוּד stripped, alone, cmp. גְּרֵירָא.]— Pl. גַּרְדּוּמִין, constr. גַּרְדּוּמֵי. Tosef. Par. XII (XI), 2 ג' אזוב stumped stalks of hyssop; ג' ציצית (not ניצית); Men. 38 b ג' תבלת remnant of the tsitsith. Sifré Num. 115 שיריה וגַרְדּוּמֶיהָ what is left of it or the stump of it; Men. 39 a שיריו וגַרְדּוּמָיו, expl. ibid. דבעינן שירא לגרדומיו a small remnant of the threads must remain on the stumps; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גרד, cmp. Targ. Jud. VIII, 6 s. v. גְּרַד; cmp. סָרַק) local de tortura e execução, cadafalso (romano) do carrasco, forca.
definicoes_originais: (גרד, cmp. Targ. Jud. VIII, 6 s. v. גְּרַד; cmp. סָרַק) place of torture and execution, ( Roman) executioner’s scaffold, gallows.
notas_originais: Sabb. 32 a העולה לג' לידון he who ascends the scaffold to be punished. Ab. Zar. I, 7 בסילקי ג' וכ' a basilica, a scaffold &c., interpreted ib. 16 b בס' של ג' a basilica for tortures, executions &c., i.e. a basilica for holding court. Pesik. Shimu, p. 118 b תלאו בגרדון ordered him to be suspended on the gallows (for torture); Y. Taan. IV, 69 b top תְּלָיָין בג' (cmp. Gitt. 57 b, a. e. מסריקנא וכ'). Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. X, end והגרדין טהור ed. Zuck. (ed. ברדין; corr. acc.) the torturer’s block is not affected by levitical impurity.
— Pl. גַּרְדּוּמֵי. Bekh. 44 a אשתיור ג' roots of the eyebrows remained visible.—Gen. R. s. 33, v. גַּרְזִימִי.
, v. גַּרְדּוֹם

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גרד) penteadeira de lã, em gen. tecelão comum, diff. frag. טַרְסִי.; (= גַּדְרִי) de Gadara, v.
definicoes_originais: (גרד) wool-dresser, in gen. common weaver, diff. fr. טַרְסִי.
notas_originais: [Our w. adopted in Greek a. Latin γέρδιος, gerdius.] B. Bath. 21 a one of the inmates of a court הרוצה לעשות … ג' that wants to open a business as … weaver. Kel. XII, 4 מסמר הג' the weaver’s pin (of the shuttle). Sabb. 93 b קנה של ג' the weaver’s cane (quill); Y. ib. X, 12 c bot. גיר'; a. fr.— Pl. גַּרְדִּיִּים, גַּרְדִּין. Kidd. 82 a; Tosef. ib. V, 14. Eduy. I, 3; Sab. 15 a.—Kil. IX, 10 גרדין, v. אוֹת II.—[

Targ. Y. Ex. XXXIX, 22; a. e.—Koh. R. to IX, 10 חד גַּרְדַּיי (some ed. גרדייא, corr. acc.); Y. Kil. IX, 32 b bot.; Y. Keth. XII, 35 a bot. גדליי (corr. acc.)— Pl. גַּרְדָּאִין, גַּרְדָּאֵי, גִּירְ'. Targ. Jud. XVI, 14 (some ed. גדרסן, corr. acc.). Targ. Is. XXXVIII, 12 (v. גִּידּוּדָא); a. e.—Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39 c bot. גירדאי.—Yoma 20 b, v. אַבּוּב. Sabb. 151 b, v. אַכְסָן.
, v. גּוֹרְדְּיָינִי.—גרדין, v. גַּרְדּוֹן.
, v. גְּרָרִיקִי
Targ. Job VII, 6 גרדית מחי (Ms. גַרְדָּיַית pl.; h. text ארג) the weaver’s thread.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Parel de גדם) cortar, cortar.; ser podado.; אִיתְגַּרְדִּים, אִיגַּרְדִּים (= גרזם, v. גַּרְזִימִי) para ser mordiscado.
definicoes_originais: (Parel of גדם) to cut off, to lop.
אִיתְגַּרְדִּים, אִיגַּרְדִּים (= גרזם, v. גַּרְזִימִי) to be nibbled at.
notas_originais: —Ithpa. אִיגַּרְדֵּם

Men. 38 b איג' תכלת וכ' if the blue fringe has been lopped off, but the white remains &c. Ib. 39 a גרדומין דאִיגַּרְדּוּם אִיגַּרְדּוּמֵי does not gardumav intimate that they (the fringes) are entirely cut off (leaving no remnant)?
Targ. Ps. XXXIX, 12 היך עמר דאית' (Ms. דאיג') like wool nibbled at (by moths; h. text כָּעָשׁ).

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Sifré Thazr., Neg. cap. Eu fiz alguma edição, li גִּרְמָנִי.
notas_originais: , Sifré Thazr., Neg. ch. I some ed., read גִּרְמָנִי.
Ab. Zar. 26 a there was among them חד גר' Ms. M. (ed. גיר') one weaver. Ib. ג' דלא טייזן, v. טַיְיזָן. [Var. גרדן, גרדנאי in Rashi a. l., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90.]
— Pl. גַּרְדָּנֵי, גִּירְ'. Keth. 60 b, v. גַּרְגְּרָנָא.
, v. גְּרָרִיקִי
, v. גרי

verbetes.glosa_atual: gerah (um grão), nome de uma moeda.; a semente de S.
definicoes_originais: gerah (a grain), name of a coin.
notas_originais: Bekh. 50 a
John’s bread, v. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גרר, v. גִּירָא II) um broto, talo (de linho ou aspargo).
definicoes_originais: (גרר, v. גִּירָא II) a shoot, stalk (of flax or asparagus).
notas_originais: Mekh. Mshp., N’zikin, s. 13 המערב את הג' בתלתן (Var. גֵּירָה, גררה) he who mixes (other) stalks among stalks of fenugrec; Yalk. Ex. 343; Tosef. B. Kam. VII, 8 גידה ed. Zuck. (Var. גירה, גורה). [Löw Pfl. p. 317: seed of St. John’s bread among seeds of fenugrec.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גרר, cmp. גָרוֹן, גַּרְגֶּרֶת); [o áspero, cmp. τραχεῖα,] garganta, laringe com traqueia, pulmões e coração.; (b. h.; cmp. גרס) comida moída, ruminante.

notas_originais: Kel. XII, 8 ג' של זית a vessel made out of a piece of an olive tree; Tosef. ib. B. Mets. II, 19 he who makes vessels מג' של זית R. S. to Kel. l. c. (ed. Zuck. גרפות, גפו, corr. acc.).—Metaph. ג' של שקמה block of a sycamore tree, i.e. a man barren of thought, ignorant; barren of merits, worthless. Tanḥ. B’ḥuck. 5 Jephtah was as poor in the Law כגְרוֹפוֹ של שקמה (ed. Bub. 7 גרופות של ש' היה, note: גרופית) as a block &c.—Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40 c; Gen. R. s. 25, end; Ruth R. s. 1, opp. ג' של זית one rich in merits; a. e.— Pl. גְּרוֹפִיּוֹת. B. Bath. V, 3 if one buys olive trees for felling, מניח שתי ג' he must leave a stump of two fists’ size (out of which new shoots may rise); Tosef. ib. IV, 7 (v. Tos’f. Y. Tob a. l., a. B. Bath. 80 b).—Gen. R. s. 31, end ג' לזתים Ar. (ed. sing.) shoots for future olive plantation.
, v. גָּרַר a. גָּרוּד.

notas_originais: Pes. 112 a ג' שנשא ג' a divorced husband who married a divorced wife. Ib. ג' בחיי בעלה marrying a divorced wife while her husband is yet alive. Ned. 20 b גְּרוּשַׁת הלב divorced at heart, one whom her husband is determined to divorce; a. fr.— Pl. גְּרוּשִׁים, f. גְּרוּשׁוֹת. Yalk. Jer. 268 וכי ג' אתם לי are ye divorced from me (the Lord)?

Gen. R. s. 19; Lam. R. introd. 4 (ref. to Gen. III, 23 sq.) דנתי אותו בשלוחין ובג' I punished him with expulsion and banishment.—Gitt. 64 a שליש אומר לגי' the trustee says (the letter has been given me not as a deposit but) as a letter of divorce which I was authorized by thy wife to receive in her behalf.—Y. Kidd. I, 58 c top גוים אין להן ג' the law of divorce (according to Deut. XXIV, 3) does not apply to gentiles. Ib. או שאין להם ג' וכ' either they have not the institution of divorce, or either may divorce the other; Gen. R. s. 18; a. fr.

R. to I, 9 ככַרְזִימִין הזה(!); Yalk. Is. 318 כגרומזי וכ' (corr. acc.). Y. Ber. VI, 10 c bot. גריזמי, גריזמתה ed. Krot. (Ar. גרוזמתא) = פִּרְפֶּרֶת a. כִּיסָנִין. Gen. R. s. 33 גרוזמי דדהב וכ' Ar. Var. (ed. גִּידּוּמֵי, גַּרְדּוּמֵי, v. גדם) golden fruits on a golden tray; Lev. R. s. 27 גרוזמין דדהב Ar. (ed. חזורין … רמונין); [Pesik. Shor, p. 74 b בחורין … ורימונין … וגקרמונין (corr. בחזריו … וגרזימין); Tanḥ. Emor 6 ובלחמא].

to be hot, burn, singe (cmp. חָרָה).
to incite, stir up, let loose.
to be inflamed, jealous; to rival.
to engage in battle, to fight.
to have a passion for, to indulge freely in.
notas_originais: Snh. 107 b שגי' דובים וכ' because he let the bears loose against the children. Ex. R. s. 21 ג' לפרעה He incited Pharaoh &c. Gen. R. s. 19, end (interpret. hishshiani, Gen. III, 13) גִּירַנִי. Cant. R. to I, 4 (play on משכני ib.) ממה שגֵּרִיתָ בי שכני הרעים from my hostile neighbors whom thou hast incited against me.—Trnsf. ג' את הדוב ב־ to let temptation loose against. Gen. R. s. 87 אני מְגָרֶה בך וכ' I shall lay temptation in thy way; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 17 ביום שיְגָרֶה וכ' on the day when the Lord shall stir up his anger &c.
נִתְגָּרֶה
Snh. 19 a מִתְגָּרוֹת זו בזו jealous of one another.
Ber. 7 b; Meg. 6 b מותר להִתְגָּרוֹת וכ' it is permitted to enter into combat with the wicked (with reference to b. h. התחרה).—Num. R. s. 19 נתג' בהם he attacked them.
Esth. R. introd. נִתְגָּרְתָה אותה הדוב that temptation was aroused (against Joseph), v. supra; Num. R. s. 13 מִתְגָּרַת.
Yoma 76 b wine is called תיר̇ש̇, because he המִתְגָּרֶה בו נעשה ר̇ש̇ who indulges in it becomes poor. Ab. Zar. 18 b; 19 b אֶתְגָּרֶה בשינה I will freely indulge in sleep (idleness).
Num. R. s. 18; Tanḥ. Koraḥ 3 להִתְגָּרוֹת בו את וכֹ' to incite Israel against him.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גרד) [casca, crosta, cmp. גָּרָב,] a superfície ressecada do campo, terra árida, solo intacto ou não cultivado.
definicoes_originais: (גרד) [ rind, crust, cmp. גָּרָב,] the parched surface of the field, arid land, unbroken or untilled ground.
notas_originais: —ימי הג' dry season, summer. B. Mets. V, 10.—Ib. חרוש עמי בג' plough thou with me in dry ground (in summer), opp. רְבִיעָה.—מקום הג' dry ground, opp. מקום הטיט (הטינא) muddy ground. Pes. 55 a; Y. Kil. II, 27 d top; Y. Ḥall. I, 57 c.—M. Kat. 6 b שדה ג', opp. מטוננת.—Y. Kil. II, 28 a bot. ג' unbroken ground between tilled fields. Gen. R. s. 33, end נעשה כג' וכ' (the earth, after the flood had subsided) became like hard unbroken ground; they planted but nothing would grow.

Ab. Zar. 37 a אם מתי ג' the mere formula ‘If I die’ (without qualification). Yeb. 20 a לא תעשה ג' הוא it is merely a prohibitory law; a. fr.— Pl. גְּרֵידֵי. Ib. 79 b חייבי לאוין ג' trespassers of a mere prohibitory law, opp. לאוין דשאר referring to incest. Ḥull. 2 b; a. fr.—Fem. גְּרֵידְתָא. Sot. 32 b אמירה ג' the expression אמר not qualified by ענה. Keth. 73 b טעות אשה אחת ג' a plain error concerning one woman (where you cannot say that the case may be considered as though concerning two different persons); a. fr.—[Targ. Y. II Ex. XIV, 25, v. גְּרַר.]
Yeb. 75 b (Ar. גרידתא).
, v. גְּרֵידָא. [Yeb. 75 b Ar., v. preced.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: , pl. גְּרִיסִין (b. h. גֶּרֶשׂ; v. גְּרַס I) [ dividido, quebrado,] grãos; especialmente. feijão triturado; feijão usado para bater.; (pl.) um prato de grãos triturados.
definicoes_originais: , pl. גְּרִיסִין (b. h. גֶּרֶשׂ; v. גְּרַס I) [ split, broken,] grits

notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 94, beg.; Nidd. IX, 6 sq.; Tosef. ib. VIII, 9, v. חֲלוּקָה a. שְׁעוּעִית.—Maasr. V, 8 ג' הקלקין Cilician beans. Tosef. ib. III, 14 [read:] אילו הן ג' הקלקין (אילו) הַגַּסִּין המרובעין (v. Maim. a. R. S. to Maasr. l. c.) Cilician beans are the large and quadrangular; a. fr. [גריסות, v. גָּרוֹסָה.]—כג' the size of a bean. Sifra Thazr. Neg. ch. I. Kel. XVII, 12 ג' נגעים כג' וכ' the garis as a standard for eruptions is the Cilician bean.
Koh. R. to II, 2; Tanḥ. Aḥaré 1, a. e. קערה של ג' a dish of boiled grit; Ruth R. to II, 14 גְּרִישִׂין. [Ib. to 15 היה מבקר גרישין, read with Yalk. ib. 604 גְּדִישִׁין, v. גָּדִישׁ.]
Y. Sabb. III, 6 b top פינכא דג' a dish of beans; Y. Maasr. I, 49 a top דגלוסא (corr. acc.).— Pl. גְּרִיסִין. Targ. Y. Lev. XIV, 37. [Ex. R. s. 43 קאקז גריסין, v. קָאקִיגוֹרוֹס.]
